text:
I counted the places where the blue oxygen saturation trace crosses the dashed line at 97.1%. The readings are whole numbers (95, 96, 97, 98), so the trace is on the upper side of the line only when it reaches 98, and on the lower side at 97 or below. Each excursion up to 98 therefore produces two crossings: one going up and one coming back down.

The excursions to 98 occur at roughly:
1. about 33–35 min
2. about 70 min
3. about 84 min
4. about 108 min
5. about 136 min
6. about 182 min
7. about 207 min
8. about 226 min

Eight excursions, each giving two crossings, gives 16 crossings.

FINAL ANSWER: 16
